fragment.choose:
<when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("alert-event-emitted", "false") != "true")">

            
            <set-variable name="_alertType" value="@{
                var explicitType = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("alertEventType", "");
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(explicitType)) { return explicitType; }

                int sc = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0;
                string src = context.LastError?.Source ?? "";
                string reason = context.LastError?.Reason ?? "";
                string msg = context.LastError?.Message ?? "";

                // Source-based classification takes precedence over raw status code
                if (src.IndexOf("content-safety", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0) { return "content-safety"; }
                if (src.IndexOf("pii", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
                    || reason.IndexOf("PIIAnonymization", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
                    || msg.IndexOf("PIIAnonymization", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0) { return "pii-failure"; }

                // Token QUOTA exhaustion returns 403 (llm-token-limit token-quota), classified by APIM
                // as "AITokenQuotaExceeded". Detect it BEFORE the generic 403 -> auth-failure mapping.
                // On-error path: context.LastError.Reason carries the classification. Outbound path:
                // fall back to the presence of a Retry-After header (set by llm-token-limit on quota/TPM
                // rejections but NOT on an auth 403).
                if (sc == 403 && (
                        reason.IndexOf("TokenQuota", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
                        || reason.IndexOf("QuotaExceeded", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
                        || msg.IndexOf("TokenQuota", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) >= 0
                        || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Response?.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Retry-After", ""))
                        || !string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Response?.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("retry-after", ""))
                    )) { return "quota-exceeded"; }

                if (sc == 429) { return "throttling"; }
                if (sc == 401 || sc == 403) { return "auth-failure"; }
                if (sc >= 500 && sc < 600) { return "backend-failure"; }
                return "none";
            }" />

            
            <set-variable name="_alertStatusCode" value="@{
                var explicitStatus = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("alertEventStatus", "");
                if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(explicitStatus)) { return explicitStatus; }
                int sc = context.Response?.StatusCode ?? 0;
                return sc.ToString();
            }" />

            
            <set-variable name="_alertEmit" value="@{
                string t = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("_alertType", "none");
                if (t == "none") { return "false"; }

                var master = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("alertsEnabled", "true");
                if (!master.Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) { return "false"; }

                string toggleName;
                bool dflt;
                if (t == "throttling")            { toggleName = "alertOnThrottling";      dflt = true;  }
                else if (t == "quota-exceeded")   { toggleName = "alertOnQuotaExceeded";   dflt = true;  }
                else if (t == "backend-failure")  { toggleName = "alertOnBackendFailure";  dflt = true;  }
                else if (t == "auth-failure")     { toggleName = "alertOnAuthFailure";     dflt = false; }
                else if (t == "content-safety")   { toggleName = "alertOnContentSafety";   dflt = false; }
                else if (t == "pii-failure")      { toggleName = "alertOnPiiFailure";      dflt = false; }
                else                              { toggleName = "";                        dflt = false; }

                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(toggleName)) { return "false"; }
                var v = context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault(toggleName, dflt ? "true" : "false");
                return v.Equals("true", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) ? "true" : "false";
            }" />

            
                <when condition="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("_alertEmit", "false") == "true")">
                    
                        
                        <dimension name="alertType" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("_alertType", "unknown"))" />

                        
                        <dimension name="statusCode" value="@(context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("_alertStatusCode", "0"))" />

                        
                        

                        
                        <dimension name="deploymentName" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("requestedModel", "NA"))" />

                        
                        <dimension name="backendId" value="@((string)context.Variables.GetValueOrDefault("selected-backend", "NA"))" />
